title: Artificial Intelligence Research, Innovation, and Accountability Act of 2024
last_action: Reported by the Senate Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation with an amendment.
status: Reported by Senate committee; expired at the end of the 118th Congress
summary: Would have established transparency, assessment, and certification duties for critical-impact artificial intelligence systems and directed federal work on testing and evaluation standards.
committee_dynamics: The committee-reported bipartisan framework demonstrated support for risk-based federal AI rules, but the bill did not receive final passage before the 118th Congress ended.
advance_rationale: The 118th Congress ended without enactment; any renewed effort requires a new measure in a later Congress.
verification_level: Official GovInfo text and legislative stage checked; end-of-Congress status applied
